terms.grammar: noun, third declension, masculine or feminine
evidence: Tert. Anim. 55: Perpetua, fortissima martyr (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: Tē glōriōsus Apostolōrum chorus, Tē Prophētārum laudābilis numerus, Tē Martyrum candidātus laudat exercitus.
phrases.english: The glorious choir of the apostles, the praiseworthy company of the prophets, the white-robed army of martyrs praise you.

sources: The Tē Deum from the Latinitas Precēs, checked against the editions named there.
